raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00). The raw duplicates are exact copies that differ only in ingest_ts, so silver_transactions double-counts them. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver fixes silver and all the gold tables built from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.95,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
